4205-4490--210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4205-4490--210.description:
Give Shalai and Hallar lifelink, if needed.
Gain life.
Bloodthirsty Aerialist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Shalai and Hallar triggers, dealing damage to an opponent and causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 3.
4205-4490--210.notes: Additional mana and/or prerequisites may be required depending on the method used to give Shalai and Hallar lifelink.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-849-2113-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-849-2113-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Anax triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

856-3899-5220-6900.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-3899-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-3899-5220-6900.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6199-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6199-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

5641-6566-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
5641-6566-7096.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2404-4644-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-2404-4644-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Tidewater Minion any number of times.

1563-2457-2837-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste and a Food token.
Activate the Cat and the Food using their abilities from Jaheira by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4885-7796.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-7796.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Precinct Captain, triggering Breath of Fury and Precinct Captain.
Resolve the Precinct Captain trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1563-2433-4321-5189.description:
Activate Ghave by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token and a Food token due to Peregrin Took.
Rosie Cotton triggers twice, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave and another +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Activate the Food by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1879-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1879-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1879-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

360-2919-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-2919-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

225-3875-5856-7513.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Food.
You have a basic Forest in your library or control a land that can tap to produce {G}.
225-3875-5856-7513.description:
Activate a Food using Silkwing Scout's ability by paying {G} and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Food token and untapping a land.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat.

1445-2921-4871-7422.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2921-4871-7422.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1824-2510-2530-2932.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1824-2510-2530-2932.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2510-2530-2932.notablePrerequisites: There is a creaature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1824-2510-2530-2932.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

147-413-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-413-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

777-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-5295-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1913-2073-2921--90.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

997-1329-1778-2178.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
997-1329-1778-2178.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1055-5909.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1055-5909.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling all but the bottom six cards of each library face down.
Activate a creature you control by tapping it, causing an opponent to mill cards equal to the creature's toughness.
Repeat step 3 as desired and/or able.
1055-5909.notes: If an opponent has zero cards in their library as they begin their turn, they will lose the game during their draw step due to attempting to draw from an empty library. Depending on how many creatures you have available, it is possible to cause multiple or all opponents to lose the game in this fashion.

2493-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Archaeomancer each turn.
2493-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying its mana cost.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

678-3967-4192-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-3967-4192-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1142-1429-2034-4350.description:
Activate Lazav by paying {2}, choosing to have it become a copy of Lesser Masticore if it doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it, or Butcher Ghoul otherwise.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lazav, adding {C}{C}.
When Lazav dies, if it was a copy of Lesser Masticore, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, Lazav's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Lazav enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

369-2386-2579-5256.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-2386-2579-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Iridescent Drake on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Iridescent Drake from your library onto the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Iridescent Drake's power.
Repeat.

353-913-2034.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
353-913-2034.notablePrerequisites: Your storm count is equal to or higher than five plus the number of times you've cast Aeve from the command zone this game.
353-913-2034.description:
Cast Aeve from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Aeve's storm ability triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of itself for each spell you've cast previously this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing the nontoken Aeve and two Aeve tokens, adding six {C}.
Choose to have Aeve returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow three times by paying {6}, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Aeve token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Aeve.
Repeat from step 1.

428-1692-4609.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to a permanent or player.
428-1692-4609.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Ghyrson Starn with haste.
Deal exactly two or three damage to a permanent or player, which is reduced to one due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token each trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to that permanent or player due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
The Ghyrson Starn token triggers, dealing 1 damage to that permanent or player due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to that permanent or player due to Ghosts of the Innocent.
 Repeat from step 5.
